lye.title: Leave year-end
lye.description: Prepare a preview of what happens to each balance at the end of a leave year, confirm it, or roll it back. A preview changes nothing.
lye.denied: You may not see leave year-end
lye.denied.body: Ask your administrator for permission to read leave year-end runs.
lye.loadError: The year-end information could not be loaded.
lye.prepare.title: Prepare a preview
lye.prepare.body: Choose the leave year. The preview is worked out in the background by the job centre and changes no balance. A new preview replaces an older unconfirmed one of the same year.
lye.prepare.year.invalid: Give the year with four digits.
lye.prepare.noJob: The year-end job is not available to you or is not set up.
lye.prepare.running: The preview is being prepared ({percent} percent).
lye.prepare.done: The preview is ready. Open it from the list below.
lye.prepare.failed: The preview could not be prepared
lye.prepare.failed.generic: The job stopped. See the job centre for details.
lye.runs.empty.body: Prepare a preview for a leave year that is over.
lye.runs.caption: Year-end runs of the company
lye.run.title: Year-end of leave year {year}
lye.preview.note: This is a preview: no balance has been changed. Confirming posts the carry-forward, payout and lapse shown below.
lye.rolledBack.title: This preview is no longer in use
lye.rolledBack.body: It was rolled back or replaced by a newer preview. Nothing was posted from it.
lye.applied.title: Confirmed
lye.applied.body: Confirmed on {at} by user {by}. {count} ledger entries were posted. This run can no longer be changed or rolled back.
lye.closed.title: The leave year will be closed
lye.closed.body: Once confirmed, the leave year is closed: no entry can be added to it any more, also for people who have left during the year.
lye.totals.caption: Year-end totals by leave type
lye.lines.caption: Year-end preview by employee and leave type
lye.filter.search.help: Part of a number is enough.
lye.status.no_policy: No leave policy: nothing happens to this balance
lye.status.separated: Left before the end of the year: left to final settlement
lye.confirm.title: Confirm the year-end of leave year {year}
lye.confirm.body: These totals will be posted to the ledger. Balances are checked again first; if they changed since the preview, nothing is posted and you must prepare a new preview.
lye.confirm.second: Depending on the company settings, the confirmation may wait for a second person to approve it in Approvals.
lye.confirm.pending.toast: The confirmation is waiting for approval.
lye.confirm.applied.title: The year-end was confirmed
lye.confirm.applied.body: The entries were posted and the leave year is closed.
lye.confirm.pending.title: Waiting for a second person
lye.confirm.pending.body: The confirmation was requested but nothing is posted yet. A second person with the right to approve must decide it. You cannot approve your own request.
lye.rollback.title: Roll back the preview of leave year {year}
lye.rollback.body: The preview is discarded and nothing is posted. This is possible only before the year-end is confirmed. You can prepare a new preview afterwards.
